# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – first touchpoint sets retention trajectory; no standardized experience means inconsistent induction, goal-setting, and coach assignment
- **Member Checkins** – no cadence for 30/60/90-day touchpoints; losing visibility on engagement drop-off and intervention windows
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no documented win-back sequence or exit interview process; bleeding members without understanding why
- **Class Quality Audit Checklist** – coaching consistency not being monitored; no mechanism to catch substandard class delivery or safety issues
- **Member data privacy & GDPR** – compliance risk; no documented process for consent, data storage, deletion requests, or incident response
- **Referral Programme** – no structure for member acquisition via word-of-mouth; missing revenue multiplier
- **Health & Safety Incident Protocol** – injury, accidents, or safeguarding concerns have no documented response path
- **Complaints & Resolution** – no formal escalation or resolution SOP; member dissatisfaction festering
- **Financial Controls** – no documented reconciliation, refund authority, or payment dispute handling

---

# **Needs updating**

- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – likely lists competencies but no link to actual performance metrics, feedback cycles, or promotion criteria; add 360 feedback and skill-gap assessment framework
- **Weekly Key Coach Tasks** – probably exists in someone's head; needs detail on pre-class prep standards, performance capture (member results), and communication with management
- **Member Outcomes & Milestone Achievements** – tracking framework incomplete; missing body comp/strength/endurance targets, celebration/milestone triggers, and member communication cadence
- **30 Day Goals** – unclear if tied to onboarding or ongoing; needs structured goal-setting template, coach review checkpoint, and adjustment protocol

# Service Menu Execution for The Forge

**1. Start with your current revenue reality — map every service you're ACTUALLY selling right now**
Pull last 3 months of transactions (memberships, classes, PT sessions, challenges, merchandise, anything). You'll likely find services selling that aren't documented, or pricing that's inconsistent. This is your truth. Build the menu around what's working, not what sounds good.

**2. Create two separate, visually distinct documents — don't try to merge them**
- **Coach version**: tier pricing, commission structures, what's included in their teaching (class prep? member programming? nutrition guidance?), boundaries on what's "included" vs. billable extras
- **Member version**: simple tier names (not jargon), clear "here's what you get" per tier, one sentence per benefit (no walls of text). Include what's explicitly NOT included to kill negotiation later

**3. Stress-test pricing against your actual costs + margin targets**
For each tier, calculate: facility cost per spot, coach time, software/admin overhead. Target 60%+ margin minimum on group offerings. If a tier doesn't hit this, it's a profitability drain — either raise price or cut it.

**4. Build in a "upsell clarity map" so coaches naturally recommend upgrades**
For every tier, explicitly note what the next tier adds. Train coaches to say: "That includes X, but for Y more you get Z." Write these scripts into the document.

**5. Version control and quick-release it in the next 7 days**
Pick one channel (WhatsApp group for coaches, one-pager email to members). Done beats perfect. Collect feedback for 2 weeks

• **Rev/member has crashed to £106 in Aug (was £145 in July).** You've added 17 members (121→153) but revenue fell £3.6k. Root cause: new members on low-tier plans or discounted intro rates. Audit TeamUp pricing tiers; move new sign-ups to standard tier (currently underpriced vs £131–145 average). Target: £130+ rev/member by November.

• **May's 12.8% churn is your red flag.** Last 3 months (Jul–Sep) average 6.6% churn vs prior 3 (Feb–Apr) at 5.1%. Retention is drifting. Implement exit surveys in TeamUp; identify the May cohort and probe why. Offer 3-month retention incentives (free PT session, class pass top-up) to members in months 2–4 of membership — cheapest retention is early intervention.

• **Quiet class fill: track attendance by time slot in TeamUp.** If morning/midweek classes run <60% capacity, move one underused slot to a peak time (typically 6–7 pm) or trial a hybrid online option to fill it without new hire cost.
